category.name: Rubber, Polymers & Roads
category.description: Asphalt, tire treads, rubber mats, silicone, carbon fiber, foams and molded plastics.

materials.name: Rubber Tread Stair
materials.description: Anti-slip metro/staircase coin-dot rubber floor mat with bevel studs. Resilient rubber flooring with raised studs, ribs and granules.

projection.tiling_note: Planar UVs aligned to the room; studs and ribs should stay axis-aligned.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 0.5 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.5 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Rubber floors trap grit and chalk dust around studs.

materials.name: Carbon Fiber Weave
materials.description: 2x2 twill carbon-fiber tech weave with crisp over-under tow relief. Woven and forged fiber composites under glossy resin.

projection.tiling_note: UV-unwrap with tows at 0/90 degrees; add a clearcoat layer for glossy resin.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 0.1 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.1 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Clearcoat scuffs lightly; never rusts.
